title_sq: Tek Komuna E Parisit, Shitet Apartament 3+1+2, Me Lokacion Perfekt, Planimetri Te Rregullt, Dhe Hapesira Te Bollshme!
description_sq: Tek Komuna E Parisit, Shitet Apartament 3+1+2, Me Lokacion Perfekt, Planimetri Te Rregullt, Dhe Hapesira Te Bollshme!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin 3 te nje pallati 10 katesh dhe ka nje siperfaqe totale 120 m2. Organizohet nga korridori shperndares, salloni i ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe 2 ballkone. Pallati ku ndodhet prona eshte i mireadministruar dhe i pajisur me ashensor. Orientimi i prones eshte nga Lindja cka mundeson ndricim natyral ne nje pjese te mire te dites. Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor dhe zona ku ndodhet prona eshte nje nga me te kerkuarat ne Tirane duke ofruar te gjitha kushtet per nje jetese komode dhe te qete.
title_en: In the Municipality of Paris, Apartment 3+1+2 for sale, with perfect location, regular layout, and ample space!
description_en: In the Municipality of Paris, 3+1+2 apartment for sale, with perfect location, regular floor plan, and ample space!!! The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a 10-story building and has a total area of ​​120 m2. It is organized by the distribution corridor, the living room together with the kitchen area, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 2 balconies. The building where the property is located is well managed and equipped with an elevator. The orientation of the property is from the East, which enables natural lighting for a good part of the day. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation and the area where the property is located is one of the most sought after in Tirana, offering all the conditions for a comfortable and peaceful life.
